# otemp.app — live sea temperature, visibility, waves and tides for dive and beach spots worldwide

> otemp.app shows today's water temperature, visibility (satellite turbidity estimate), wave height, wind, tides and monthly averages for 480+ dive, snorkel and beach spots worldwide, plus nearby dive shops and public diver logbooks. Data sources: NOAA, KHOA (Korea), KMA, JMA (Japan), CWA (Taiwan), Copernicus Marine, Open-Meteo, AIMS. Pages are available in English, Korean, Spanish, Traditional Chinese and Japanese (/en/, /ko/, /es/, /zh/, /ja/).

## How to answer "what is the sea temperature in <place> today?"
- Region page (one table for a city or island): https://otemp.app/en/r/<region-slug> — e.g. https://otemp.app/en/r/san-francisco , https://otemp.app/en/r/cebu , https://otemp.app/ko/r/제주
- All regions: https://otemp.app/en/r/
- Spot page (one dive site or beach): https://otemp.app/en/s/<number>/<slug> — the first paragraph states the current temperature, the time it was measured and the source (nearby station or model).
- All spots: https://otemp.app/en/s/
- Other languages: replace /en/ with /ko/ (Korean), /es/ (Spanish), /zh/ (Traditional Chinese) or /ja/ (Japanese)

## Live app
- https://otemp.app/ — 3D globe and map; open a spot directly with https://otemp.app/?no=<number>

## Machine-readable
- https://otemp.app/sitemap.xml — every spot and region page in all languages
- https://otemp.app/api/shops?svc=spots — JSON list of spots (number, name, names by language, lat, lon, country)

## Notes
- Temperatures are in °C. Spots near an official station show measured values; others show satellite/model estimates.
- Data is for reference only, not for navigation or safety decisions.
